details:
ASTROVITAL AI is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and wellbeing platform developed by Team Bleu MarByte for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to support astronauts during long-duration space missions through two monitoring modes: SPACEMOVE – CABIN and SPACEMOVE – EVA. The platform combines physiological data visualization, Machine Learning anomaly detection, and a local AI Companion powered by Qwen 2.5 3B.

The project was developed using Python, Streamlit, Scikit-learn, and Ollama. Its initial anomaly detection model uses synthetic data, while ESP32-based sensor integration is planned for future development.

ASTROVITAL AI is innovative because it brings health monitoring and AI-assisted wellbeing support together in a local-first architecture, designed to maintain essential capabilities despite communication delays with Earth.

Inspired by NASA research, our team considered key spaceflight challenges such as isolation, confinement, altered gravity, astronaut wellbeing, data privacy, and communication reliability. Future improvements include real sensor integration, NASA-grounded knowledge retrieval, and a secure Medical Portal.

Our ultimate goal is to contribute to safer, more human-centered space missions by supporting astronauts' physical and psychological wellbeing.
